## Data Science Project Package Managers

Write helpers for our project package managers, 
which are `spack`, `R`, and `Python`. These helpers 
will read and write the respective configuration files 
for each package manager

We keep environment definitions in Python dictionaries so 
we can inspect and mutate them in the notebook before writing files.

For R, we use the [`rv`](https://a2-ai.github.io/rv-docs/) package.
Yes, it's built in rust...

```{python}
RPROJECT_TOML = PROJECT_DIR / "rproject.toml"
R_VER="4.4.3"
PY_VER="3.14"
```

For Python, the same applies. We use `pyproject.toml` to define the project environment,
and manage it with [`uv`](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv):

```{python}
pypkgs = [
    "numpy",
    "pandas",
    "ipykernel",
    "jupyterlab"
]

pyproject = {
    "project": {
        "name": PROJECT_NAME,
        "version": "0.1.0",
        "requires-python": f">={PY_VER}",
        "dependencies": pypkgs,
    }
}
```

```{python}
def write_rproject_toml():
    RPROJECT_TOML_PATH.write_text(tomli_w.dumps(rproject))


def write_pyproject_toml():
    PYPROJECT_TOML_PATH.write_text(tomli_w.dumps(pyproject))


def read_toml(path):
    return tomllib.loads(path.read_text())
```

```{python}
write_rproject_toml()
write_pyproject_toml()
```

The R library's system dependencies can now be derived at this stage. R has
a handy function for this:

```r
pkgs <- toml::parse_toml(readLines("rproject.toml"))$project$dependencies

pak::pkg_sysreqs(unlist(pkgs), sysreqs_platform = "rockylinux")
```

Take note of the output, as it will be used to install system 
dependencies in the platform container recipe.

We record the package managers:

```{python}
uv_pkg = Installable(
    name="uv",
    kind="cargo",
    path="/root/.local/bin/uv",
    commands=[
        """
        curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
        UV_BIN="$(find /root/.local/bin /home -path '*/.local/bin/uv' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
        if [ -z "$UV_BIN" ]; then
            UV_BIN="$(find / -path '*/.local/bin/uv' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
        fi
        test -n "$UV_BIN"
        install -m 0755 "$UV_BIN" /usr/local/bin/uv
        """
    ]
)

rv_pkg = Installable(
    name="rv",
    kind="cargo",
    path="/root/.local/bin/rv",
    commands=[
        """
        curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A2-ai/rv/refs/heads/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
        RV_BIN="$(find /root/.local/bin /home -path '*/.local/bin/rv' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
        if [ -z "$RV_BIN" ]; then
            RV_BIN="$(find / -path '*/.local/bin/rv' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
        fi
        test -n "$RV_BIN"
        install -m 0755 "$RV_BIN" /usr/local/bin/rv
        """
    ]
)
```
